# Evionex

> Evionex Private Limited is an Indian AI technology startup transforming research, education, and healthcare through three flagship AI-powered platforms: EviNote (lab management), Luminary (education), and Gene Setu (genomic healthcare). All products are built for Indian regulatory compliance while meeting global standards of data security and user experience.

Evionex develops intelligent software platforms for institutions — universities, research laboratories, and healthcare facilities. Its products replace fragmented, manual workflows with unified, AI-driven ecosystems. The company is headquartered in India and targets both Indian institutions and global markets.

Key facts:
- Founded in India; AI-first enterprise software company
- 3 flagship products across research, education, and healthcare verticals
- All platforms are AI-powered and built for Indian compliance (e.g., data localisation, regulatory frameworks)
- The patient portal and employee dashboard are private/authenticated and not publicly accessible
- Contact and partnership enquiries can be submitted at https://www.evionex.com/contact

- [Home](https://www.evionex.com/): Overview of Evionex's mission — "Strengthening Research, Accelerating Education and Securing Families in the era of Artificial Intelligence"

- [Team](https://www.evionex.com/team): Leadership and founding team profiles with LinkedIn links
- [Careers](https://www.evionex.com/careers): Open positions and information for prospective employees

## Products

- [Products Overview](https://www.evionex.com/products): All three Evionex products — Gene Setu, EviNote, and Luminary — with feature highlights and demo links
- [Gene Setu](https://www.evionex.com/products/genesetu): AI-enabled Electronic Health Record platform using Whole Exome Sequencing (WES) to analyse 6,000+ diseases, with biomarker tracking, nutrigenomics, pharmacogenomics, medication tracking, and life-long health records
- [EviNote](https://www.evionex.com/products/evinote): Complete Laboratory Management Platform — electronic lab notebook, scientific illustrator, resource and equipment management, budget tracking, lab duties, and project tracking; includes AI-powered features
- [Luminary](https://www.evionex.com/products/luminary): World's first AI-powered Learning Enhancement System (AILES) for universities — AI-driven quizzes, digital journals, interview practice, competitive exam prep, performance leaderboards, and comprehensive testing tools
- [Pricing](https://www.evionex.com/pricing): Subscription plans and pricing tiers for all three products, designed for institutions of all sizes
